description: Native MiniCPM vision through vcruz305’s ExLlamaV3 and TabbyAPI forks, pinned to 475461e9 and 880e6b8b. A build-time TabbyAPI repair loads vision directly on the single GPU, avoiding text-shaped autosplit measuring forwards (see the packaged VISION_LOAD.md). Defaults to the creator’s 4,096-token vision profile with FP16 KV and plain decoding. Optional long-text profile uses 262,144 tokens with Q4 KV. Exact creator checkpoint, immutable CUDA 13.0 image and hash-locked Torch 2.14.0 cu130 dependencies. The memory envelope is a conservative estimate; container and physical model acceptance remain separate.
title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 EXL3 SAGE 3.74bpw TabbyAPI (vcruz305)
